$comment: Private data the public repository must not hold (private-data-guard D-1). Checked by scripts/rules.mjs in every text file, at the edit, before each commit and in CI. Each exception names a file (or * for any), the value and why it stays.

emails.message: A real email address: use an example.org address, or add an exception with its reason.

identifiers.message: A GUID that is not synthetic: real directory, client and object ids live in user secrets. Use a GUID with a zero group (0198f5ee-0000-…), or add an exception with its reason.

hosts.message: A real identity directory host: use a placeholder such as <subdomain>.ciamlogin.com.

paths.message: A path on a personal machine: use a path relative to the repository.

ips.message: A public IP address: use a documentation range (192.0.2.0/24) or a private one.

exceptions.reason: The example GUID of the OpenAPI tooling, used in API client fixtures.
